Tragic civilian toll in Pryluky after missile strike.

#Ukraine #Pryluky #Aletheia

Tireless emergency responders working around the clock to save trapped residents.

The report confuses a tactical military pretense with pure humanitarian devastation, framing state violence as routine conflict.

The Unavoidable Lie: Such catastrophic civilian losses are merely regrettable collateral damage of war.

My heart breaks for the families and little ones lost beneath the rubble in Pryluky today. No political ambition is worth a single child's laughter silenced forever.

Tragic news coming out of Ukraine. Three kids pulled from the rubble is just heartbreaking, no words for this kind of destruction.

Innocent lives crushed under rubble mock every claim of righteous conflict.

The death toll from a Russian missile strike on Pryluky in Chernihiv Oblast has risen to nine, and 38 people have been injured. Rescue workers are still clearing the rubble.

Quote: "As of 11:30, the death toll has risen to nine. Sadly, the bodies of three children have been recovered from under the rubble of the apartment building.

Thirty-eight people have been injured, including seven children."

Details: Search and rescue operations are currently underway to find people trapped under the rubble.

Nina Lutsenko, spokesperson for the State Emergency Service in Chernihiv Oblast, said three people, including a child, had been rescued.

Five children aged three, five, eight and nine, as well as a police officer, are among those injured.
